none: PAS NLM-E3E502: Zoomorphic vessel spout from Winteringham
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Vessel. Cast zoomorphic pouring spout from a copper alloy vessel. The spout is modelled as a panther's head with a long arching neck and a flat-ended muzzle. An inscribed vertical line flanked by nostrils (apparently blind features) between nose and mouth on the snout ends in a round pouring hole of diameter 4mm.
